title: Governance Service API Contract
description: Core governance engine: proposal state transitions, audit, knowledge publishing. Domain: Governance.
note: Governance is a pure Python module (no Flask). Called internally by Proposals and Chat services.

functions.name: transition_proposal
functions.description: Central state machine for all proposal status changes. ALL status transitions MUST go through this function.

conn.description: Optional; caller manages commit if provided

functions.name: get_agent_active_proposal
functions.description: Get the in_progress proposal for an agent (if any).

side_effects.auto_checkpoint: in_progress and done transitions create git checkpoints (A.1.3)
side_effects.auto_publish: done transitions publish summary to swarm_knowledge (A.3.2)
side_effects.audit_log: Every transition logged to governance_log table
